newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil minors badly burned in New Year Eve escape.
newsitem.headline: Brazil minors badly burned in New Year Eve escape.

text.p: A group of young Brazilian offenders were badly burned and others escaped when inmates in a detention centre started a fire late on New Year's Eve, local Globo television said on Wednesday.

An official at the Padre Severino institute in Rio de Janeiro said it was not yet clear exactly how many inmates had escaped or were injured but, according to Globo, 23 of the 190 young offenders at the institute broke free in the confusion.
Some 40 minors were burned, eight seriously, in the fire started in two of the institute's five accommodation blocks using mattresses and furniture, Globo said.
